description: This file defines authentication API functions for the React frontend, including login, signup, and retrieving user profile information. It interacts with backend endpoints related to authentication tasks.

methods.name: login(email, password)
methods.description: Authenticates a user with email and password, returning an access token or an error object.

methods.name: signup({ email, password, full_name })
methods.description: Creates a new user account with given email, password, and optional full name, returning the created user data or an error.

methods.name: me()
methods.description: Fetches the profile data of the currently authenticated user.

ctags.name: signup
ctags.pattern: /^export async function signup({ email, password, full_name }) {$/
